name: SEX with HITLER
source:
Sex With Hitler is a unique blend of visual novel and top-down shooter.You will fight in the fields of World War II and meet five unique heroines, among whom you will find both friends and enemies.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1849000/SEX_with_HITLER/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《性与希特勒》是视觉小说和自上而下射击游戏的独特结合。你将在第二次世界大战的战场上战斗，并遇到五位独特的女主角，在她们中间你会发现朋友和敌人。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1849000/SEX_with_HITLER/]Steam[/url]]
